title: Teacher-written character study 'The Clockmaker'
subject: English
unit: Summer 2: Time Traveller and Off with Her Head!
source: Seeded from english/y5 lesson 82 (Teacher-written character study 'The Clockmaker' (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 82: What is a character study? Reading a description of a clockmaker (VIPERS). To understand how a character study uses appearance, actions and speech to reveal character

questions.q: Find a simile in the description
questions.model: I do: look for as or like: as wrinkled as old maps.

questions.q: What does Mr Hamid say about time?
questions.a: Time is a gift. Never waste it.
appearance (it may also hint he notices things)

questions.q: find three appearance details and three character traits with evidence
questions.model: I do first: Appearance: wrinkled hands. Trait: careful, because his hands never shook with a tiny cog.

questions.q: answer: what do Mr Hamid's words tell us about him? (PEE)
questions.a: For example: he values time and wants others to use it well

questions.q: add one sentence that shows a new trait through an action
questions.a: For example: He left the shop light on so travellers could see the time.
